description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with Effect from 04.11.2024 to 10.11.2024.
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, falls under legal/statutory instruments category, and involves compliance requirements for import/export transactions - all characteristics of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
